sources.artifactHashSource: SHA256 field in the signed/reviewed package index
sources.licenses: per-package Debian copyright metadata; Apache-2.0/GPL/LGPL/BSD/MIT and compatible notices
sources.ownership: scripts/fetch-runtime-libs.ps1 records each staged runtime path to its resolving package and runtime-lock.json hashes the final packaged ELF

releaseRequirement: Runtime regeneration must retain the reviewed package index, package versions, artifact URLs, package hashes, license metadata, runtime-path ownership, and SONAME closure as CI evidence before an externally signed runtime lock is accepted.
